clue.text: Trendy city where one avoids a complete soaking

definitions.text: where one avoids a complete soaking

blocks.note: hip means fashionable, in the know
Bath is a Roman spa city in Somerset, England

explanation.surface: A fashionable spa town where visitors somehow stay dry.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a playful description: a hip bath is a small tub you sit in, so only your lower half gets wet.
explanation.definitionFit: A hip bath covers only the seated lower body, so the bather never goes fully under the water.

clue.text: One taken with the net, perhaps, using computer — one only

the Roman numeral for one

explanation.definitionFit: This large flatfish is commonly landed by trawlers, so it is one example of a catch hauled aboard in nets.

clue.text: Lift, open and restart after repairing

blocks.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Instructions for an elevator that has broken down: open it and start it again once fixed.

explanation.definitionFit: A paternoster is a type of elevator whose open compartments circulate continuously, so passengers step on and off while it moves.

clue.text: Ridiculous muscles seen on Murdo when stripped

clue.text: Drop a trail of blood?
